title: Steampunk Eye of the City
description: A massive biomechanical cat-like machine with glowing orange eyes and multiple mechanical legs strides through a dark, foggy cyberpunk city street filled with glowing neon signs. In the foreground, an enormous stylized green cat eye with a vertical slit pupil and intricate fiery patterns dominates the scene, surrounded by swirling purple and lime green smoke and psychedelic patterns.
